sources.snippet: Kenga: A Language Model with Inherent Identity Kenga, developed by GermannM, is a 1.5 billion parameter language model built on a transformer decoder architecture, featuring a 32K token context length. Unlike many general-purpose models, Kenga is designed with a specific identity, knowing it is "Kenga," who created it, and its core values. It is primarily optimized for the Russian language ...
